# Luis Reche

> Applied AI Engineer in Palma, Spain. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex write the code. I decide what to build, design how it works and answer for what ships. Since 2023 I have taken products from a customer's problem to production: web, mobile, desktop, backend and infrastructure.

## Experience

- Applied AI Software Engineer at Agentero, Apr 2026 to present. Built, end to end, the internal app that partly automates month-end commission payments. Maintained and extended the marketplace where independent insurance agents reach carriers, across the Go backend on Google Cloud and the Next.js interface.
- Freelance Applied AI Engineer for SocialPro, 2025 to present. Built and launched socialpro.es and did its SEO: monthly Google impressions went from 155 to 18,700 and clicks from 16 to 285 between April and September 2026. Built the brand portal and the first CRM of the agency. Delivered the complete website of Pirotecnia Elche, a client of the agency.
- Freelance Applied AI Engineer at RecheDev, 2023 to present. Took my own and client products from the first conversation to production. Created ClipHub and Gravity Room. Tuned PCs for competitive players, overclocked their hardware and built custom machines.
- Pharmacist, 10 years. Decided which products to bring in and how to sell them, managed the database behind multi-warehouse stock and planned purchasing from stock and sales statistics.

## Projects

- [ClipHub](https://cliphub.rechedev.cloud/): my own Windows app that turns a Counter-Strike 2 demo into an edited video of the player's best plays. 130+ releases, 100+ users. Shared with SocialPro.
- [Gravity Room](https://gravityroom.app): my own free, open source strength training app for web and mobile. 18 programs, with the weights, sets and reps of every session calculated.
- [Piroboom](https://pirotecniaelche.es): the complete website of Pirotecnia Elche, a fireworks shop in Elche. Its 82 MB PDF catalogue is now a 16-page online reader with search and zoom.
- [SocialPro](https://socialpro.es): the public website, the brand portal and the first internal CRM of a gaming and esports agency.
- [Honey Encryption Proxy](https://github.com/rechedev9/honey-encryption-proxy): a local proxy for Claude Code that swaps proprietary names in a prompt's code for stand-ins and restores them in the reply.
- [riskforge](https://github.com/rechedev9/riskforge): an insurance quote gateway that asks several carriers for a price in parallel. A study project.

## Stack

- Product: Product scoping, UX and interface design, SEO, Release management

- Backend: Go, Bun, Elysia, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SQLite
- Web: TypeScript, React, Next.js, TanStack, Astro, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile and desktop: Expo, React Native, Electron, Rust core with UniFFI
- Infrastructure: Docker, GCP, Terraform, Vercel, GitHub Actions
- Hardware: PC builds, Overclocking, Latency tuning
